text: 2045 is 2045 - Empresa de Segurança, S.A., a Portuguese private-security company founded on 1 March 1990 by Major General Jaime Neves and Captain Sousa Gonçalves. Its own pages name the company and its founders but do not state its current shareholding.
short: 2045 is a Portuguese private-security company founded in 1990 by Jaime Neves and Sousa Gonçalves.

source.name: 2045 - Empresa de Segurança — Empresa page
source.quote: Fundada a 1 de março de 1990 pelo Major General Comando Jaime Neves e pelo Capitão Comando Sousa Gonçalves
